    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.

algorithm: {The algorithm assigns higher priority to bins that can accommodate the item with minimal leftover space, favoring bins with the smallest excess capacity after adding the item, while penalizing bins that cannot fit the item at all.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    leftover = bins - item
    # Bins that cannot fit the item get a very low priority (negative infinity)
    invalid_bins = leftover < 0
    # For valid bins, prioritize those with smaller leftover space (closer to full)
    priorities = np.where(invalid_bins, -np.inf, leftover)
    # Invert the priorities so smaller leftover space means higher priority
    return -priorities
